steps.en: Initialize your React + Tailwind project, picking a base library and style
steps.zh: 初始化 React + Tailwind 项目，选好底层组件库和风格

steps.en: Installs dependencies, adds the cn helper and writes theme CSS variables
steps.zh: 安装依赖，加上 cn 工具函数，写好主题 CSS 变量

steps.en: Ask for the components you need by name
steps.zh: 按名字要你需要的组件

steps.en: Copies each component's source into your repo and installs its base-library deps
steps.zh: 把组件源码拷进你的仓库，并装上它依赖的底层库

steps.en: Import the file from your own folder and edit it like any of your code
steps.zh: 从你自己的目录导入，像改自己的代码一样改它

value.en: Polished, accessible components whose source lives in your repo — restyle or rewrite any of them without waiting on a library release
value.zh: 精致、无障碍的组件，源码就在你的仓库里——想改样式、想重写都不用等组件库发版

sources: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/cli.mdx (init installs dependencies, adds the cn util, configures CSS variables; --base base|radix|aria; add command)
